payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the woman’s jacket front more closed in the edit, and is it fully closed?
node.criteria: Compare the jacket’s front-panel position and overlap in the source versus the edit. complete: the panels meet/overlap so the jacket is fully closed. partial: the panels are visibly closer together or overlap more than in the source, but the jacket remains partly open. absent: the jacket is not more closed than in the source. Do not infer closure progress from pose, motion, or reduced visibility of an inner layer alone. unknown: pose, occlusion, or image ambiguity prevents a reliable comparison.
node.binding: Visual target: the woman’s jacket front panels. Compare their visible separation/overlap between source and edited images; do not use pose or inner-layer visibility as a proxy.

outcome.description: The woman’s jacket is closed fully.
outcome.reference: Make her close her jacket fully
